SELECT oauth.id, USER.username, oauth.platform_name, oauth.platform_username, oauth.platform_user_avatar, oauth.create_time FROM sys_oauth oauth LEFT JOIN sys_user USER ON oauth.user_id = USER.id
USER.deleted = 0
AND USER.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{queryParams.username},'%')
AND oauth.platform_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{queryParams.platformName},'%')
AND oauth.create_time >= #{queryParams.startTime}
AND oauth.create_time <= #{queryParams.endTime}
order by oauth.create_time DESC
